Hello! I'm [Hylke](https://github.com/hbons), the maintainer of [SparkleShare](https://github.com/hbons/SparkleShare).

I like to talk and connect with people. I want to know what you have to say and I believe we have much to gain when we learn from eachother.

That's why use of Large Language Models (LLMs), both in code and communications, is not allowed. An exception is made for crossing language barriers.

Before opening a Pull Request, let's discuss the changes that you'd like to make in advance. Oneliners and trivial patches are fine.
